description: Parity: Settings' action buttons are one height, as the Tauri panel's .set-btn were: Import, Reset… and Open permission setup… are as tall as Export, and so are the reset confirmation's Delete everything and Cancel.
requirement: P2-settings-buttons (GPUI Phase 2b parity, Tauri ee80e70:dist/panel.css .set-btn, dist/index.html set-export/set-import/set-reset)
notes: Heights are the buttons' measured bounds (view.layout.<name>_button.h, views/layout.rs), compared against Export's in the same state read.
Export keeps its accent look (the R14 accent sample, theming.json); only the heights must agree.
Must fail on the instrumentation commit (before the fix) at 'Import is as tall as Export' (24 vs 28 pt).
rc.4: the Permissions section's 'Open permission setup…' (view.layout.permissions_button) is one of the action buttons and must match Export's height too.

steps.name: Import is as tall as Export
Reset… is as tall as Export
Open permission setup… is as tall as Export
the confirmation's buttons are as tall as Export
